Defining the basis vectors of the output beam frame. The Beam frame should stay "right-handed" even after the reflection; therefore the new basis vectors should be obtained by rotation from the previous basis vectors. The rotation should be around the axis perpendicular to the plane of incidence (i.e. plane of reflection) and the rotation angle is the angle between the incident and the reflected central beams (i.e. optical axes before and aftre the reflection). const double relTolZeroVect = 1.e-10; const double relTolZeroVectE2 = relTolZeroVect*relTolZeroVect;
